Multi-slot: item (eggs) + list_name (shopping list) dispatched after 2nd reply

root_cause_old_failure.issue: Previous add_to_my_list ADB test failure was a test harness design flaw, not an app routing bug
details: The original add_to_my_list case used a single slot_reply 'eggs' for a 2-slot intent (add_to_list requires item + list_name)
After filling 'item', the app prompted for 'list_name' — intent never dispatched
capture_fresh_logcat timed out (30s) and picked up stale set_timer marker from previous test
Fix: Changed to slot_replies=['eggs', 'groceries'] sending both required slots
This is NOT a MiniLM classifier or routing issue — pure test harness design error

harness_limitations: Device ring buffer contamination: adb logcat readers start from oldest entry, not 'now'
Running all 6 tests in one invocation causes stale markers from earlier tests to match later test expectations
Each test passes individually when run in isolation
adb logcat -c corrupts logd on this S21 (Exynos/OneUI) — cannot clear buffer between tests
Workaround: run targeted cases individually; test design ensures independent verification
